chrome.helpText: Need help? Contact our support team
chrome.footerNote: This is an automated message; please do not reply.
chrome.footerNoteCode: This is an automated verification code message; please do not reply.
chrome.copyLinkHint: Copy the following link into your browser:
chrome.codeExpiresInWithAt: Use this code within {minutes} minutes (expires at {time}, {timeZone})
chrome.defaultSecurityTip:
• Use this code only for this action; never share it
• If this was not you, ignore this email
• Complete verification in time or request a new code

verification.subject: Verify your {appName} email address
verification.title: Verify your {appName} email address
verification.preheader: Welcome to {appName}! Verify your email address to finish signing up.
verification.message: Thanks for signing up for {appName}! To keep your account secure, verify your email address with the button below.
verification.reminder:
• This link expires in 24 hours
• If you did not create a {appName} account, ignore this email
• Never share this link with anyone to keep your account safe
verification.securityTip: {appName} will never ask for your password, verification code or other sensitive information by email.

loginOtp.subject: Your {appName} sign-in code
loginOtp.title: Your {appName} sign-in code
loginOtp.message: You are signing in to {appName}. Use the code below to continue:
loginOtp.securityTip: If this was not you, ignore this email and review your account security.

emailVerificationOtp.subject: Verify your {appName} email address
emailVerificationOtp.title: Verify your {appName} email address
emailVerificationOtp.message: Thanks for signing up for {appName}! Use the code below to verify your email address:
emailVerificationOtp.securityTip: If you did not create this account, ignore this email.

passwordResetOtp.subject: Reset your {appName} password
passwordResetOtp.title: Reset your {appName} password
passwordResetOtp.message: Someone requested a password reset for your {appName} account. Use the code below to reset it:
passwordResetOtp.securityTip: If this was not you, ignore this email and check your account security right away.

magicLink.subject: Your {appName} sign-in link
magicLink.title: Your {appName} sign-in link
magicLink.preheader: Click to sign in securely without a password.
magicLink.message: Use the button below to sign in to your {appName} account securely, without a password:
magicLink.reminder:
• This link expires in 15 minutes
• The link can be used once
• If this was not you, ignore this email
magicLink.securityTip: For your security, do not share this link with anyone.

emailChange.subject: Confirm your email change - {appName}
emailChange.title: Confirm your email change - {appName}
emailChange.preheader: Confirm changing your email address to {newEmail}
emailChange.message:
You are about to change your email address to {newEmail}.

To confirm, use the button below:
emailChange.reminder:
• This link expires in 24 hours
• After the change, sign in with the new email address
• If this was not you, ignore this email
emailChange.securityTip: For your security, this confirmation link was sent to your current email address.
